entry.title: New: Bill 177 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS ORDINANCE NO. 24-32, AS AMENDED, THE OPERATING BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF HAWAI‘I FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDING JUNE 30, 2025

Appropriates revenues in the Federal Grants – Justice Assistance Grant-Special Response Team Capability Enhancement grant account ($50,537)

Latest action: Council: Bill 177 passes second & final reading - 8/07/2024
